notes: Portal: ford.com Owner's Manual & Warranty library (https://www.ford.com/support/owner-manuals-details/owner-manuals-library -> /support/owner-manuals-details/{model}/{year}). Access: free, no login or VIN needed (VIN search optional). Each year/model page is a Next.js page whose server-rendered payload (ownerManualsData) lists every document with category, printing, isoLanguage EN-US and the link; documents are hosted on Ford's content host www.fordservicecontent.com (PDF: /Ford_Content/Catalog/owner_information/... and older /Ford_Content/catalog/owner_guides/...; HTML owner manual viewer: /Ford_Content/vdirsnet/OwnerManual/Home/Index?...marketCode=US). BLOCKER for automation: from this network (AZ) both www.ford.com and www.fordservicecontent.com return Akamai 'Access Denied' (HTTP 403) to non-browser HTTP clients (httpx/curl, even robots.txt), while the same pages and PDFs load normally in a real browser from the same IP - i.e. bot protection, not a geo-block. Therefore pages were read in a normal browser session (no login, no captcha encountered) and every link was verified from the browser on the fordservicecontent.com origin with fetch + Range bytes=0-1023 on 2026-10-02: all 106 PDFs returned HTTP 206, %PDF, application/pdf (size_bytes from Content-Range); all 16 HTML owner-manual viewer links returned HTTP 200 text/html. A scripted pipeline will need a real browser to fetch these files. US edition: all items are tagged isoLanguage EN-US on the US site; HTML viewer links carry countryCode=USA&marketCode=US. Two PDF printings are joint US/Canada English editions by file name (2018 Fusion Owner's Manual Printing 2 'EN-US-EN-CA'; 2017 Fusion Hybrid/Energi Owner's Manual Printing 2 'EN-US_EN-CA'). Ford lists several printings per year; all owner-manual printings are included (the highest printing number is the latest). Hybrid and Energi (plug-in) share one owner manual per year on Ford's 'Fusion Hybrid/Energi' page (2014-2019) and 'Fusion Hybrid/PHEV' page (2020); all are under line fusion with the variant in the title. Maintenance: Ford publishes the scheduled-maintenance chapter inside the owner's manual for these years; no separate maintenance guide is listed on any Fusion page. doc_type warranty_maintenance = Ford 'Warranty Guide' (Car/Light Truck or Hybrid/EV). doc_type other = owner's manual supplements (MyFord Touch, warranty addendum cards, police supplements for the Fusion Hybrid police/Police Responder variants), tire warranty and California emissions warranty guide. Excluded generic items present on the pages: Roadside Assistance cards, Sirius radio card, MyFord Mobile guide; a 2020 Fusion Hybrid QRG that Ford also lists on the 2019 Hybrid/Energi page is kept only under 2020. Caveat: the 2014 Fusion Hybrid/Energi 'Energi Quick Reference Guide Printing 2' link listed by Ford points to a file named 2014-Focus-Energi-QRG-... (content not inspected).
